product: Genie Code scheduled tasks are now generally available
tagline: Genie Code scheduled tasks are now generally available.
what_it_does: Genie Code scheduled tasks are now generally available. You can schedule Genie Code to run a prompt on a recurring schedule. Each run executes your prompt as a full Genie Code session and produces a continuable Genie chat with the results, so you can turn recurring analysis and other work into an unattended background task.
why_it_matters: A scheduled run accesses data and performs operations using the permissions of the user who created the task, governed by your Unity Catalog permissions.
plain_summary: Genie Code scheduled tasks are now generally available. You can schedule Genie Code to run a prompt on a recurring schedule.
key_takeaway: Genie Code scheduled tasks are now generally available.
